passage.quote:
The specification is authored using upstream TorchLean's `nn.Sequential`, with
a linear layer from shape `[1024]` to `[3072]` followed by ReLU.

summary: Define the upstream TorchLean sequential linear/ReLU architecture, its explicit weight-then-bias state, and its evaluation-mode forward program from shape [1024] to [3072].

from.quote:
The layer's architecture is an upstream TorchLean `nn.Sequential [1024] [3072]`
containing `nn.linear 1024 3072` followed by `nn.relu`. The linear layer owns a
weight tensor of shape `[3072, 1024]` and a bias tensor of shape `[3072]`. ReLU
has no parameter state.

The model's state layout is therefore `[[3072, 1024], [3072]]`, in weight-then-bias
order. An explicit parameter state contains the supplied weights and bias.
These tensors can have any values of the selected scalar type; they are not
restricted to the builder's initialization.

passage.quote:
/-- The linear layer owns weights and bias, in that order; ReLU adds no state. -/
theorem state_shapes : nn.stateShapes model = [[3072, 1024], [3072]] := by
  rfl

/-- Supply arbitrary weights and bias instead of using initialized model state. -/
def parameters {α : Type} [Storage α]
    (W : Tensor α [3072, 1024]) (b : Tensor α [3072]) :
    nn.State α (nn.stateShapes model) :=
  (nn.State.empty.push W).push b

from.quote:
The evaluation-mode forward program takes the weights, bias, and input in that
order, and returns a tensor of shape `[3072]`. It uses the sequential model's
upstream forward program. Tensor operations are interpreted by the supplied
TorchLean operation backend.

passage.quote:
/-- The upstream sequential forward program takes W, b, and x and returns y. -/
def forwardProgram {α : Type} [Storage α] [Context α] :
    Runtime.Autograd.Model.Program α [[3072, 1024], [3072], [1024]] [3072] :=
  model.forward .eval

from.quote:
The Lean package pins TorchLean and its transitive dependencies and contains no
dependency on the PTXLean package.

passage.quote:
name = "ptxlean_relu_layer"
version = "0.1.0"
defaultTargets = ["ReluLayer"]

[[require]]
name = "TorchLean"
git = "https://github.com/lean-dojo/TorchLean.git"
rev = "de3192df4779877ceb65cfe470a4d4ce9d480a5b"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "ReluLayer"
moreLeanArgs = ["-M5120"]
